meta.notes:
## 2026-11-13 additions
**LIVE** = `querySelectorAll` in headless Chrome (puppeteer), logged out, `/pin/1125968640422478/` and `/search/pins/?q=kitchen island`, iPhone UA 390x844 and macOS Safari UA 1280x800. Counts are total (visible).
- **Desktop sign-up (fixes a gap):** `[data-test-id="fullPageSignupModal"]` 1 on desktop pin and search: a full-page "Welcome to Pinterest" dialog on a 60% black layer; the wrapper has no box of its own, so it counts as not visible although its fixed children cover the page. It ships `<style>body{overflow:hidden !important}</style>`; with the modal hidden the window still scrolled 1200 px (checked), because the scroller is the root. `[data-test-id="bottom-right-upsell"]` 1 (1) desktop pin and search: fixed box "You are signed out / Sign in". Both joined **Hide the sign-up pop-up**. The Google card top-right is the One Tap iframe (existing rule).
- **Desktop suggested pins:** on desktop the pin page is `relatedPins`, whose first list item is the pin itself, so `relatedPins` must never be hidden there. `[data-test-id="relatedPins"] [role="listitem"] [data-grid-item-idx]:not([data-grid-item-idx="0"])` 12 (all but the first) on desktop, 5 on mobile; the pin itself is grid item 0 and stays (checked by injecting the rule). The rule avoids `:not(:has())` on purpose: the recipe selector engine does not need that nesting.
- `[data-test-id="aggregated-comment-list"]` 1 and `comments-count-container` 1 on desktop pin (the comment box is inside the latter); none on mobile.
- `[role="listitem"]:has([data-test-id="gated-pin-video"], [data-test-id="story-pin-video-block"])` 1-3 (all) on pin and desktop search; `PinTypeIdentifier` ("0:10" badge) matches the same cards.
- `[data-test-id="one-bar-module-3"]` 9 (9) mobile search, 25 (25) desktop search: the chips (Small, Pendant lights...). `one-bar-module-0` is the filter button and stays.
- `[data-test-id="visual-search-icon"]` 1 (1) desktop pin. Pin pictures: `gated-pin-rep img` 8 mobile search, 14 desktop search; `pin-closeup-image` is a div on desktop and an img on mobile, so the rule filters the element itself.
## SOURCE only (not seen logged out; hand-written fixture `feed-logged-in.html`)
Promoted pins, shopping and the signed-in grid selectors come from the Pinterest Power Menu userscript (`div[role="listitem"]:has(div[title="Sponsored"])`, `Shoppable Pin indicator`, `product-price-text`, `duplo-shopping-module`, `ShopTheLookSimilarProducts`, `related-products`, `shopping-module`, `pinWrapper`, `pin`) and uBlockOrigin/uAssets issue 18369 (`[data-test-id="otpp"]` inside a list item). No sponsored pin or shopping module appeared logged out. Pin and desktop grids use masonry with absolute positions, so a hidden card leaves a gap.
## Original check (LIVE, iPhone UA, 2026-11-08)
Home, pin, profile, board, search. All anchors are `data-test-id`/role, no hashed classes. `signup-popup-dialog` 1 on pin, profile, board and search (0 on home, where the sign-up screen is the page); the gated grid stays scrollable and no second pop-up came in 25 s. `home-promo-sections` 3, `home-bottom-signup` 1, `home-footer-links` 1 on `/` only; `pin-more-to-explore` 1, `pin-more-like-this-button` 2, `pin-comment-button` 1, `pin-author-followers` 1 on the pin; `board-more-like-this` 1; `profile-follow-counts` 1. Desktop home (2026-11-10): Google One Tap `#credential_picker_container`.
## Not verified
Logged-in pages, regional hosts (`nz.`, `uk.`), cookie banners, an un-gated desktop pin grid. The related-pins selectors also hide the real pins under a pin, by design.
